question: 统计 2025 年第一季度各校区的消费总额
gold_sql: SELECT c.campus, ROUND(SUM(f.amount),2) AS 消费总额 FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_stall s ON f.stall_id=s.stall_id JOIN dim_canteen c ON s.canteen_id=c.canteen_id JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025 AND d.quarter='Q1' AND f.refund_flag=0 GROUP BY c.campus ORDER BY 消费总额 DESC

question: 统计 2025 年第一季度各食堂的消费次数
gold_sql: SELECT c.canteen_name, COUNT(*) AS 消费次数 FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_stall s ON f.stall_id=s.stall_id JOIN dim_canteen c ON s.canteen_id=c.canteen_id JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025 AND d.quarter='Q1' AND f.refund_flag=0 GROUP BY c.canteen_name ORDER BY 消费次数 DESC

question: 统计 2025 年 3 月各餐次的消费总额
gold_sql: SELECT f.meal_type, ROUND(SUM(f.amount),2) AS 消费总额 FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025 AND d.month=3 AND f.refund_flag=0 GROUP BY f.meal_type ORDER BY 消费总额 DESC

question: 按学院统计 2025 年第一季度的人均消费
gold_sql: SELECT s.college, ROUND(SUM(f.amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT f.student_id),2) AS 人均消费 FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_student s ON f.student_id=s.student_id JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025 AND d.quarter='Q1' AND f.refund_flag=0 GROUP BY s.college ORDER BY 人均消费 DESC

question: 查询紫金港校区消费总额最高的前 5 个档口
gold_sql: SELECT s.stall_name, ROUND(SUM(f.amount),2) AS 消费总额 FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_stall s ON f.stall_id=s.stall_id WHERE s.campus='紫金港校区' AND f.refund_flag=0 GROUP BY s.stall_name ORDER BY 消费总额 DESC LIMIT 5

question: 比较本科生和研究生的消费次数
gold_sql: SELECT s.student_type, COUNT(*) AS 消费次数 FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_student s ON f.student_id=s.student_id WHERE f.refund_flag=0 GROUP BY s.student_type ORDER BY 消费次数 DESC

question: 统计各校区的消费人数
gold_sql: SELECT c.campus, COUNT(DISTINCT f.student_id) AS 消费人数 FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_stall s ON f.stall_id=s.stall_id JOIN dim_canteen c ON s.canteen_id=c.canteen_id WHERE f.refund_flag=0 GROUP BY c.campus ORDER BY 消费人数 DESC

question: 统计不同支付方式的消费金额
gold_sql: SELECT f.payment_method, ROUND(SUM(f.amount),2) AS 消费金额 FROM fact_consumption f WHERE f.refund_flag=0 GROUP BY f.payment_method ORDER BY 消费金额 DESC

question: 统计各食堂午餐消费次数
gold_sql: SELECT c.canteen_name, COUNT(*) AS 午餐次数 FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_stall s ON f.stall_id=s.stall_id JOIN dim_canteen c ON s.canteen_id=c.canteen_id WHERE f.meal_type='午餐' AND f.refund_flag=0 GROUP BY c.canteen_name ORDER BY 午餐次数 DESC

question: 统计各年级的人均消费
gold_sql: SELECT s.grade, ROUND(SUM(f.amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT f.student_id),2) AS 人均消费 FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_student s ON f.student_id=s.student_id WHERE f.refund_flag=0 GROUP BY s.grade ORDER BY 人均消费 DESC

question: 查询消费金额最高的 10 个学生
gold_sql: SELECT s.student_name, ROUND(SUM(f.amount),2) AS 消费金额 FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_student s ON f.student_id=s.student_id WHERE f.refund_flag=0 GROUP BY s.student_name ORDER BY 消费金额 DESC LIMIT 10

question: 统计各菜品类别的消费份数
gold_sql: SELECT s.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS 消费份数 FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_stall s ON f.stall_id=s.stall_id WHERE f.refund_flag=0 GROUP BY s.category ORDER BY 消费份数 DESC

question: 统计退款记录数量
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 退款次数 FROM fact_consumption WHERE refund_flag=1

question: 统计各校区的平均客单价
gold_sql: SELECT c.campus, ROUND(SUM(f.amount)/COUNT(*),2) AS 平均客单价 FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_stall s ON f.stall_id=s.stall_id JOIN dim_canteen c ON s.canteen_id=c.canteen_id WHERE f.refund_flag=0 GROUP BY c.campus ORDER BY 平均客单价 DESC

question: 统计 2025 年各月份消费总额
gold_sql: SELECT d.month, ROUND(SUM(f.amount),2) AS 消费总额 FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025 AND f.refund_flag=0 GROUP BY d.month ORDER BY d.month
